 1                   I.      INTRODUCTION AND QUALIFICATIONS

 2   Q1.   PLEASE STATE YOUR NAME, BUSINESS ADDRESS.

 3   A.    My name is Steven A. Sierra. My business address is 100 North Stanton Street,

 4         El Paso, Texas, 79901.

 5

 6   Q2.   ON WHOSE BEHALF ARE YOU SUBMITTING THIS TESTIMONY

 7   A.    I am filing this testimony on behalf of El Paso Electric Company ("EPE" or "the

 8         Company").

 9

10   Q3.   HAVE YOU PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED TESTIMONY IN THIS

11         PROCEEDING?

12   A.    Yes. I submitted Direct Testimony in this proceeding on March 27, 2026.

13

15   Q4.   WHAT IS THE PURPOSE OF YOUR SUPPLEMENTAL DIRECT

16         TESTIMONY?

18         Bench Request Paragraph 9.c.

 2         III.   SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION RESPONSIVE TO THE PRE-

 3                                   HEARING BENCH REQUEST

 4   Q5.   WHAT HAS THE COMMISSION REQUESTED IN PARAGRAPH 9.c OF

 5         THE PRE-HEARING BENCH REQUEST?

 6   A.    Paragraph 9.c of the Pre-Hearing Bench Request requests “[t]he amounts of

 7         executive compensation, by position, that EPE seeks to recover in its cost of

 8         service.”

 9

10   Q6.   IN RESPONSE TO PARAGRAPH 9.c., WHAT ARE THE AMOUNTS OF

11         EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION, BY POSITION, THAT EPE SEEKS TO

12         RECOVER IN ITS COST OF SERVICE.

13   A.    Exhibit SAS-1S provides the New Mexico jurisdictionalized amounts of executive

14         compensation, by position, that EPE seeks to recover in its New Mexico cost of

15         service. This includes annualized base salaries as of September 30, 2025, and a

16         three-year average of non-financial short term incentive plan (STIP) amounts, after

17         applying the three-year average payroll and three-year average STIP expense ratios,

18         respectively.

    DECLARATION OF STEVEN A. SIERRA IN SUPPORT OF THE FOREGOING
                AMENDED FILING DIRECT TESTIMONY

       I, Steven A. Sierra, pursuant to Rule 1-011 NMRA, state as follows:

       1.      I affirm in writing under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of

New Mexico that the following statements are true and correct.

       2.      I am over 18 years of age and have personal knowledge of the facts stated herein.

I am employed by El Paso Electric Company ("EPE" or “the Company”) as the Director of

Financial Accounting.

       3.      I have reviewed the foregoing Amended Filing Supplemental Testimony of Steven

A. Sierra, and the exhibits, schedules, and workpapers sponsored by me and I confirm, to the best

of my knowledge, that those materials are complete, accurate, internally consistent, and consistent

with the Amended Application.

       4.      The foregoing Amended Filing Supplemental Testimony of Steven A. Sierra,

together with all exhibits sponsored therein and attached thereto, is true and accurate based on my

knowledge and belief.

       5.      I submit this Declaration, based upon my personal knowledge and upon information

and belief, in support of EPE’s Amended Application for Revisions of Its Retail Electric Rates

Pursuant to Advice Notice No. 317.
